events.title: Employee is killed by contact with an energized power line
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Vi Water And Power Authority. St Thomas, VI. At 7:00 p.m. on September 12, 2017, an employee was adjusting the bucket of truck and preparing to repair an electrical transmission line. While elevated in the bucket, the employee came into contact with an energized power line. The employee was killed due to electrocution.
